Name: Extended Minecart
Author: Entoarox
Description:
[b][center]﻿As of the release of 1.6 this mod is deprecated.
The game now natively supports the features necessary, so a simple ContentPatcher patch will do the job.
For a 1.6 mod that provides similar functionality, please see [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11881]Integrated Minecarts[/url].﻿

Thanks for all your support while this mod remained active![/center]
Install steps[/b]
[list=1]
[*][url=https://smapi.io/]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*][b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5521]Install Entoarox Modding Utilities[/url]﻿.[/b]
[*]Unzip the download into Stardew Valley/Mods.
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]

[b]Use[/b]
This mod adds new minecart destinations that function as both in and out spots. Some of these destinations unlock immediately, while others have requirements (like the Quarry). As a side-effect of having more places to go, the carts now have a small chance to run out of fuel and require you to input 5 coal before you can use them again.
(The chance of this refueling being needed can be changed or disabled in the config file)

Made by request of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/users/1552317]Pathoschild[/url] as a somewhat Christmas gift, so share the thanks with him if you like it!


[b]Compatibility[/b]
[list]
[*]Compatible with...[list]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.3.32 or later;
[*]Linux, Mac, and Windows;
[*]single-player and multiplayer.
[/list]
[/list]
